method: One stable base-of-neck point in the source clip (source_anchor, in source pixels) is pinned to one screen point (screen_anchor, on the 1080x1920 canvas) at every cut. Only scale changes. build.py turns each cut's scale into the x/y transform, so identical scales always give identical crops. No eye, head or hand following; no re-centring at pause trims.
how_to_find_the_anchor: Open a frame of your clip at source resolution, note the pixel where the collar meets the base of the neck, and put it in source_anchor. screen_anchor is where that point should sit on the finished frame; 540,820 keeps the eyes near the upper third for a seated talking head. Save the reference frame as qa/neck-reference.jpg so the next edit uses the same point.
